portfolio.statement: Kotak Mid Cap Fund manages Rs 66,613 crore in AUM, concentrated primarily in Financials (27%), Healthcare (16.5%), and Technology (12%), with its top 10 positions comprising 28.4% of total assets.
interp: The portfolio recorded a 3-month loss of -6.51%, heavily pulled down by sharp pullbacks in Fortis Healthcare (-22.52%) and retail player Vishal Mega Mart (-14.41%).

Positive returns from IT holdings like Persistent Systems (+15.43%) and Mphasis (+4.30%), alongside Solar Industries (+7.97%), provided partial resilience against industrial and non-bank financial weakness.
portfolio.line: A mid-cap equity strategy caught between steep drawdowns in healthcare and consumer staples against steady momentum in technology and defence materials.

drivers.text: Fortis Healthcare fell -22.52% following Supreme Court audit developments and hospital sector weakness, generating a -0.806% contribution drag.
Vishal Mega Mart (-14.41%) and L&T Finance Holdings (-15.36%) detracted a combined estimated -0.887% from fund returns.
Technology holdings Persistent Systems (+15.43%) and Mphasis (+4.30%) mitigated losses with a combined contribution of +0.361%.
